title: Structural and dynamical aspect of DNA motif sequence specific binding of AP-1 transcription factor.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级原子模拟研究AP-1转录因子bZIP结构域与DNA基序的特异性结合，揭示DNA形状、离子分布及螺旋运动在识别中的动态机制，高度契合TF-DNA互作建模课题。
abstract: Activator protein-1 (AP-1) comprises one of the largest and most evolutionary conserved families of ubiquitous eukaryotic transcription factors that act as a pioneer factor. Diversity in DNA binding interaction of AP-1 through a conserved basic-zipper (bZIP) domain directs in-depth understanding of how AP-1 achieves its DNA binding selectivity and consequently gene regulation specificity. Here, we address the structural and dynamical aspects of the DNA target recognition process of AP-1 using microsecond-long atomistic simulations based on the structure of the human AP-1 FosB/JunD bZIP-DNA complex. Our results show the unique role of DNA shape features in selective base specific interactions, characteristic ion population, and solvation properties of DNA grooves to form the motif sequence specific AP-1-DNA complex. The TpG step at the two terminals of the AP-1 site plays an important role in the structural adjustment of DNA by modifying the helical twist in the AP-1 bound state. We addressed the role of intrinsic motion of the bZIP domain in terms of opening and closing gripper motions of DNA binding helices, in target site recognition and binding of AP-1 factors. Our observations suggest that binding to the cognate motif in DNA is mainly accompanied with the precise adjustment of closing gripper motion of DNA binding helices of the bZIP domain.
abstract_zh: 激活蛋白-1（AP-1）包含最大且进化上最保守的真核转录因子家族之一，作为先锋因子发挥作用。AP-1通过保守的碱性拉链（bZIP）结构域实现DNA结合相互作用的多样性，这引导了对AP-1如何实现其DNA结合选择性及随之而来的基因调控特异性的深入理解。在此，我们基于人AP-1 FosB/JunD bZIP-DNA复合物的结构，利用微秒级原子模拟，探讨了AP-1 DNA靶标识别过程的结构和动力学方面。我们的结果显示，DNA形状特征在选择性碱基特异性相互作用、特征性离子分布以及DNA沟槽的溶剂化性质中发挥独特作用，以形成基序序列特异性的AP-1-DNA复合物。AP-1位点两端的TpG步骤通过修饰AP-1结合状态下的螺旋扭转，在DNA的结构调整中起重要作用。我们探讨了bZIP结构域内在运动在靶位点识别和AP-1因子结合中的作用，表现为DNA结合螺旋的开合夹持运动。我们的观察表明，与DNA中同源基序的结合主要伴随bZIP结构域DNA结合螺旋闭合夹持运动的精确调整。
